name: Emmental
description: Wedges of cheese in rows, facing left and right in turn: a pale top, a wax rind at the back and a front face bored with holes of every size.

code.style: --rule: ( --z0: @r(1); @x(even) { transform: scaleX(-1); } @random(${shapeFrequency}) { -webkit-clip-path: @var(--wedge); clip-path: @var(--wedge); background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 69.6%, @p(var(--color4), var(--color5)) 69.6%); --holes: radial-gradient(circle at @r(26%, 66%) @r(58%, 90%), transparent @r(5%, 10.5%), #000 0), radial-gradient(circle at @r(26%, 66%) @r(58%, 90%), transparent @r(5%, 10.5%), #000 0), radial-gradient(circle at @r(26%, 66%) @r(58%, 90%), transparent @r(5%, 10.5%), #000 0), radial-gradient(circle at @r(26%, 66%) @r(58%, 90%), transparent @r(5%, 10.5%), #000 0); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--front); clip-path: @var(--front); -webkit-mask: @var(--holes); mask: @var(--holes); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--color3); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--top); clip-path: @var(--top); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
